models.label: ECMWF IFS 0.25°
models.note: ECMWF's operational physics model, open-data release. Its gust field is a maximum over the output interval, not an instantaneous value, so gust factors look large in light air.

models.label: ECMWF AIFS
models.note: ECMWF's machine-learning model - a genuinely independent opinion. Publishes no gust field, so gusts come from IFS and ICON-2i only.

models.label: ItaliaMeteo ICON-2i
models.note: ItaliaMeteo / ARPAE high-resolution model for Italy - the finest grid available here. Runs only ~60-72 h ahead and updates every 12 h, so it drops out of the longer-range view.

models.label: Météo-France MFWAM
models.note: Full sea-state decomposition - total wave, wind wave and swell with heights, directions and periods.

models.label: ECMWF WAM 0.25°
models.note: Total significant wave height only - used to cross-check MFWAM.

briefing.headline: Benign night at Portorosa and a near-calm 22 nm motor-sail to Lipari — leave 06:00 to carry what little breeze there is.
briefing.synopsis: The payload gives no pressure-chart data, so this is a wind-field read rather than a surface analysis: the islands sit under a very slack gradient with nothing organised in the flow. Consensus hourlies (all models, sampled 6-hourly) have Portorosa at 3-4.5 kt from the SE through the night, collapsing to around 2.3 kt and backing N/NE by midday tomorrow, then 2.3 kt NE at 18:00. Seas are flat across the group — 0.1 ft wave and 0.1 ft swell at every island through 05 Oct in MFWAM (03 Oct 00Z) and ECMWF WAM (03 Oct 06Z). Through 05 Oct a light NW breeze fills in around the northern islands, 4-5 kt at Lipari and Panarea, still nothing of consequence.
briefing.overnight_anchorage: Tonight is Portorosa Marina — enclosed, all-round shelter, and the only option listed; the choice does not matter in this weather. Forecast at the berth is 3.8 kt ESE gusting 7.8, swell 0.1 ft (ECMWF IFS 0.25°, 03 Oct 06Z, with ICON-2i 12Z in support). Nothing in the payload would give the fleet a reason to move.
briefing.tomorrow_morning: Portorosa → Lipari, 22 nm on 342°T, computes as 'go' in every window with a recommended departure of 06:00 and no deterioration flagged. The 06:00 slot has 4.7 kt SSE gusting 10.1, 0.1 ft sea, TWA 174 — a dead run in very light air, so expect to motor-sail; arrival around 09:00. Later departures are worse, not better: by 10:00 it is 1.8 kt ENE and from 12:00 the breeze goes N/NNE at 3-4 kt, putting you head to wind under engine for the whole leg. Take the early window.

passage_notes.note: 06:00 departure: 4.7 kt SSE, gusts 10.1, 0.1 ft sea, run. All windows 'go'; after 10:00 the wind backs to N/NNE at 2-4 kt and it becomes a motor straight into it.
Steady NW 4.0-4.9 kt all day, gusts to 9.5, 0.1 ft sea — close reach, TWA 74-80. No timing pressure; all windows 'go'.

NW 4.3-6.1 kt, gusts to 11.5, 0.2-0.3 ft sea. Berth at Marina del Gabbiano is rated only 'workable' — open from every direction, no anchoring, shelter depends entirely on it staying calm (3.5 kt NNW, gusts 8.0, 0.5 ft swell forecast).

passage_notes.leg: Stromboli → Panarea, optional return (06 Oct, 11 nm, 219°T)
passage_notes.note: Very light, 2.1-3.5 kt E backing SE, gusts under 6, 0.5 ft sea. Effectively a motoring day.
S-to-ESE 3.8-6.4 kt, 0.5-0.7 ft sea. IFS shows interval-max gusts to 11-12 kt against 4 kt means in the mid-morning windows — a light-air artefact, flagged but not treated as a caution.
Best breeze early: 6.8 kt S at 06:00 on a beam reach, fading to 2.5 kt by midday. 0.7-0.8 ft sea.

The one lively day: 16.6 kt WSW at 06:00, rising to 19.5 kt W in the 08:00 window, which trips the 'caution' threshold on sustained wind; 11-13 kt thereafter, sea 0.9-1.2 ft. Six days out — treat as a trend only.

cautions: Stromboli's Marina del Gabbiano, if the optional leg is taken on 05 Oct, is open through 360° with no anchoring permitted; it only works while the forecast stays as calm as it currently reads.
Expect to motor most of tomorrow and 06 Oct — winds of 2-5 kt. Plan fuel and engine hours accordingly.

Several windows show a published gust lower than the sustained wind (e.g. 19.5 kt mean / 10.7 kt gust on 09 Oct). That is a cross-model mismatch — gusts come only from IFS and ICON-2i, with no gust field from AIFS — so do not read those gust figures as a ceiling.
briefing.confidence_note: Run-to-run stability over the last five cycles is 0.5 kt mean wind shift at 0-12 h and 0.7 kt at 12-24 h, and IFS, AIFS and ICON-2i all agree on light-air conditions for tomorrow — though direction shifts average 25-29° at these leads, which matters when the mean is only 4 kt.

verification.measures: forecast stability, not verified accuracy - the reference is the newest model run for the same hour, not an observation
